title: Japanese Pecan Nut Stew
description: A fusion of Japanese and American flavors, this stew brings together the nutty taste of pecan nuts and the savory taste of stew.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, soy sauce, and enough water to cover the ingredients.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the pecan nuts and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional nuts if desired.
